name: bedrock-spend-guard
description: Deploys an account-wide Amazon Bedrock spend circuit breaker: a monthly AWS Budget filtered to Amazon Bedrock whose budget action attaches a Deny(bedrock:*) policy to named IAM groups and roles at 100% of the limit, plus a scheduled Lambda that detaches it on the 1st at 12:00 GMT so access resumes. Idempotent, account-agnostic, with a mandatory account confirmation gate and a full teardown path.
